name: AppPlug
what: The plug for apps that only know how to print. It runs one app, parses its console lines into paths per a manifest, publishes ONE link into State (app -> this door), and answers /api/resolve with the value and the moment it was seen. A quiet app answers 'stale', a dead one 'gone' - never the last number. A namespace a live adapter already holds is refused, and killing the adapter takes the app with it.
